main_body: Thatched-roof hut: a large thatch roof slope (rows 0-36) over a plank-and-door wall (rows 37-63) with a window and a door
top_band: Thatch roof slope, tan/gold with L 126-214 in tile-like courses, rows 1-34, ending in a light eave band at rows 34-36
evidence: The roof is a large foreshortened surface of thatch courses, as in the Beodeul house references. A lighter eave lip at rows 34-35 marks the front edge, with a dark shadow band at rows 37-39 beneath it. The wall below carries a door with an inset dark frame and iron straps, and a shuttered window with a dark opening. No receding side faces are drawn. The roof and wall both read as correct 3/4 parts.

style.evidence: The thatch has about 6 lightness steps with per-course highlights, and flat-fill coverage is 0%. Density is 10 colours per tile against 11 and 18 for the references, with only 29 distinct colours against 66 and 185. The dark edge pixels are 78% near-neutral black, against 7-9% in the references, so the silhouette has the uniform near-black sticker outline rather than a tinted dark-material outline. This outline difference fails the style bar next to the references.
